scares.description: (Night #5) Katie suddenly wakes up out of bed gasping for air.
(Night #5) The noise of something banging comes from another room.
(Night #13) The couple wake up in their bed and a loud noise sounds from another room, followed by a bang.
(Night #15) Micah enters the house again where he hears a bang.
(Night #21) Micah’s body is hurled at the screen from the doorway.
(Night #21) Katie crawls up to the screen and lunges at it as her face begins to turn demonic.
